expr: return { title: document.title, ready: document.readyState, hasDropzone: !!document.querySelector('.dropzone'), hasInput: !!document.querySelector('.dropzone input[type=file]'), nav: [...document.querySelectorAll('.nav__item')].map(n=>n.textContent.trim()), sw: !!navigator.serviceWorker.controller, theme: document.documentElement.dataset.theme };

const card = document.querySelector('[data-file-card]'); return { name: card.querySelector('.filecard__name').textContent, badges: [...card.querySelectorAll('.badge')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()), chips: [...card.querySelectorAll('.chip')].map(c=>c.textContent.trim()) };

const card = document.querySelector('[data-file-card]'); return { state: card?.dataset.state, progressLabel: card?.querySelector('.optrow__label')?.textContent, notes: [...document.querySelectorAll('.case__detail')].map(e=>e.textContent.slice(0,120)).slice(0,6) };

const card = document.querySelector('[data-file-card]'); return { state: card?.dataset.state, results: [...document.querySelectorAll('.result__name')].map(n=>n.textContent), errors: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-status=fail] .case__detail')].map(e=>e.textContent.slice(0,200)), notes: [...document.querySelectorAll('.case__detail')].map(e=>e.textContent.slice(0,140)).slice(0,8) };
